summary:
Iteration 9 frontend-only verification of i18n diffs against /guides, /masterclasses, /masterclasses/propagation, and /plants/tomato in DE, FR, and JA. 10/12 scoped checks PASS, 2 NEW HIGH bugs found:

PASS:
- /guides: all 5 cards (first-pot, small-spaces, kitchen-scraps, cut-flowers, companion-planting) render translated label/title/blurb AND CTA in DE ('Leitfaden öffnen'), FR ('Ouvrir le guide'), JA ('ガイドを開く'). Verified via [data-testid='guide-card-*'] text capture.
- /masterclasses section headers [data-testid='section-foundations'] / [data-testid='section-flowers'] show translated label+title+description: DE 'GRUNDLAGEN / Grundlagen / Drei strukturierte Kurse…' + 'NACH BLUMEN / Blumen-Meisterkurse / Tiefe Einblicke…'; FR 'FONDATION / Fondations' + 'PAR FLEUR / Masterclass Florales'; JA '基礎 / 基礎コース' + '花別 / 花のマスタークラス'.
- Masterclass cards: titles+taglines translated (e.g. 'Vermehrung', 'Schädlingsbekämpfung', 'Pflanzenpflege', 'Multiplication', 'Lutte contre les Ravageurs', '繁殖', '害虫対策'). Duration via t('mc.duration_about') renders 'Etwa 45 Minuten' / 'Environ 45 minutes' / '約45分' on all cards EXCEPT sweet-pea (see HIGH bug below).
- /masterclasses/propagation: sidebar h2 shows 'Vermehrung'/'Multiplication'/'繁殖'; content-side eyebrow shows 'Lektion 1' / 'Leçon 1' / 'レッスン1' (NOT 'LESSON 1' — bug from iteration 8 fixed).
- Progress placeholder substitution intact: DE '0 von 6 abgeschlossen', FR '0 sur 6 terminées'.
- localStorage 'patchpot.lang.v1' persists across reloads in all 3 languages.
- ZERO console errors / ZERO compile errors during all switches; only the pre-existing ShareCard.jsx exhaustive-deps eslint warning is in logs (non-blocking).
- Home page feature card translations from iteration 8 did NOT regress.

FAIL (2 new HIGH bugs):
1. Missing i18n keys 'mc.title.sweet-pea' and 'mc.tagline.sweet-pea' in ALL 31 languages including English — Masterclasses listing card [data-testid='masterclass-card-sweet-pea'] renders the literal raw key text. In JA: '約25分mc.title.sweet-peamc.tagline.sweet-pea0/5 レッスン'. All other 15 slugs (propagation, pest-control, plant-care, seasonal-planting, rose, dahlia, peony, tulip, lily, cosmos, zinnia, sunflower, aster, chrysanthemum, lavender) HAVE their keys. The data slug is 'sweet-pea' (confirmed in /app/frontend/src/data/flower-masterclasses.js line 158).
2. AIPlantDetail container 'Yes/No' fix is on the WRONG file. The actual route '/plants/:id' maps to PlantDetail.jsx (App.js line 28), NOT AIPlantDetail.jsx (which is mounted at '/plants/ai/:slug', App.js line 27). PlantDetail.jsx line 50 still reads `value={plant.container ? "Yes" : "No"}` — hardcoded English. Verified in browser at /plants/tomato in DE: TOPF spec value renders 'Yes' (should be 'Ja'). The t('common.yes')/t('common.no') keys ARE correctly populated in all 31 languages — only the call-site is wrong/missing.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing translation keys 'mc.title.sweet-pea' and 'mc.tagline.sweet-pea' across ALL 31 languages (including English base block at lines ~207-236). The Sweet Pea masterclass card renders raw key strings instead of localized text. All other 15 masterclass slugs are present.

Hardcoded 'Yes' / 'No' for container spec. The iteration 9 fix targeted AIPlantDetail.jsx (route /plants/ai/:slug) but /plants/tomato and /plants/basil route to PlantDetail.jsx (route /plants/:id, App.js line 28). Replace `plant.container ? "Yes" : "No"` with `plant.container ? t("common.yes") : t("common.no")`. Keys already exist in all 31 langs.

action_items: Add 'mc.title.sweet-pea' and 'mc.tagline.sweet-pea' translation pairs for all 31 languages in /app/frontend/src/i18n/index.jsx (English base + 30 other locales). Use the existing translations for sweet pea content from data/flower-masterclasses.js as a starting point.

Fix /app/frontend/src/pages/PlantDetail.jsx line 50: change `value={plant.container ? "Yes" : "No"}` to `value={plant.container ? t("common.yes") : t("common.no")}`. AIPlantDetail.jsx is fine, but it's not the component users actually see on /plants/tomato.

Optional: audit other Spec values on PlantDetail.jsx (plant.sun, plant.water, plant.soil, plant.difficulty, plant.edible_part) — these are still pulled from English data and remain English in non-EN locales, consistent with the documented scope-limit on data-layer translation. NOT blocking this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: Route confusion: PlantDetail.jsx and AIPlantDetail.jsx are near-duplicates with the AI version receiving the t('common.yes/no') fix while the legacy version (which is what /plants/:id actually serves) was missed. Consider deprecating one or sharing a Spec sub-component.

i18n key audit gap: there is no compile-time check that every masterclass slug has matching mc.title.<slug> + mc.tagline.<slug> entries. The sweet-pea regression slipped through because of this. Recommend adding a small dev-time validation that iterates ALL_MASTERCLASSES keys and warns on missing i18n entries, or auto-falls-back to the English data string.

Positive: t() placeholder substitution still works correctly with both numeric ({n}) and named ({min}, {current}, {total}) placeholders across DE/FR/JA. The lesson_number and duration_about helpers are clean.
Positive: zero console errors, language persistence stable, no regression on Home feature cards (verified DE 'Leitfaden öffnen' still wired).

success_rate.frontend: Iteration-9 diffs: 10/12 scoped acceptance criteria PASS. Failing: (1) sweet-pea card missing keys in i18n, (2) PlantDetail.jsx /plants/:id container value still hardcoded 'Yes'/'No'.

seed_data_creation: none — read-only language switching against existing content
context_for_next_testing_agent: When verifying fixes: (a) localStorage.setItem('patchpot.lang.v1','de') + reload /masterclasses → confirm [data-testid='masterclass-card-sweet-pea'] no longer contains the literal 'mc.title.sweet-pea' / 'mc.tagline.sweet-pea' strings; expect German title (e.g. 'Edelwicken') and German tagline. (b) /plants/tomato in DE → TOPF spec value should show 'Ja' (and 'Nein' for a non-container plant). Confirm in FR ('Oui'/'Non') and JA ('はい'/'いいえ'). Note: the existing English-data leakage of plant.summary, plant.sun, plant.water, plant.soil, plant.difficulty, plant.edible_part, companion cards is the documented scope-limit and is NOT in scope for this fix — do not flag.
rca of the issue:
Bug A (sweet-pea keys): when the main agent batch-added mc.title.<slug>/mc.tagline.<slug> for all 15 masterclasses across 31 languages, the sweet-pea slug was simply skipped — no key was inserted in the EN base block, so t() falls back to returning the key literal. Reproduce: localStorage.setItem('patchpot.lang.v1','en'); visit /masterclasses; the Sweet Pea card shows raw 'mc.title.sweet-pea'. Mitigation: add the 31 language pairs (en + 30) following the same pattern used for the other 15 slugs.

Bug B (PlantDetail Yes/No): two near-identical detail components exist (PlantDetail.jsx for /plants/:id, AIPlantDetail.jsx for /plants/ai/:slug). The iteration-9 diff only patched AIPlantDetail.jsx line 102, but the route the test request points at (/plants/tomato) is served by PlantDetail.jsx, whose line 50 was left as `plant.container ? "Yes" : "No"`. Reproduce: localStorage.setItem('patchpot.lang.v1','de'); visit /plants/tomato; TOPF spec → 'Yes'. Mitigation: mirror the AIPlantDetail.jsx line 102 change into PlantDetail.jsx line 50 (and import useI18n if not already).
